Good tinned fish, indifferent service. Would go back alone and not with a group.
Fine. Genuinely fine, and I have nothing else to say about it, which is the review.
The best thing I ate this quarter. Order the second soup, not the famous one.
Correct in every way and slightly airless. Worth it once a year for the sauces.
Reliable, loud, good chips. The kind of place I am glad exists and never think about.
Numbing and excellent. Ask for the off-menu greens; they are the point.
Overreached. Four ingredients too many on every plate and a room too bright to linger in.
